question: The first Bose-Einstein Condensate (BEC) made of which atom was reported by the team of Eric Cornell and Carl Wieman in 1995?
solution:
The correct answer is __**87Rb**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first Bose-Einstein Condensate (BEC)** was made of **rubidium-87 (87Rb)** atoms and was reported by the team of** Eric Cornell and Carl Wieman at JILA in 1995**.
 
• There are four states of matter common in everyday life that is gases, liquids, solids, and plasmas.
 
 
• However, there is also the fifth state of matter that is Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs), which scientists first created in the lab 25 years ago.
 
 
 
• ​Bose-Einstein Condensate (BEC):
 
 
• When a group of atoms is cooled to near absolute zero, the atoms begin to clump together, behaving as if they were one big super-atom.
 
• ​Bose-Einstein Condensate is used to study quantum mechanics on a macroscopic level.
 
 
• Light appears to slow down as it passes through a BEC, allowing scientists to study the particle/wave paradox.
 
• A BEC also has many of the properties of a superfluid or a fluid that flows without friction.
 
• BECs are also used to simulate conditions that might exist in black holes.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Fermionic condensate:

 
 
• It is called a Sixth matter state.
 
• Most of their basic properties are unknown.
 
• It was created by cooling a cloud of 500,000 potassium-40 atoms to less than a millionth of a degree above absolute zero.
 
• They probably flow without viscosity.
 
• Fermionic condensates are related to BECs. Both are made of atoms that coalesce at low temperatures to form a single object.
 
 
 
• Dark matter:
 
 
• By fitting a theoretical model of the composition of the universe to the combined set of cosmological observations, scientists have come up with the composition that we described above, ~68% dark energy, ~27% dark matter, ~5% normal matter.
